articles.title: Whoa! A Faraway Planet Might Have Air Like Earth!
articles.summary: Astronomers found helium gas escaping from a rocky planet 48 light-years away. It’s the first time we’ve seen an atmosphere on a planet in the “Goldilocks zone” where life could exist. The planet, LHS 1140 b, is a super-Earth bigger than ours.

articles.title: Digging a Ditch, Finding a 1,300-Year-Old Treasure!
articles.summary: Workers in Thailand dug under a giant reclining Buddha statue and found a ceramic pot with 33 ancient gold, silver, and bronze ornaments. The treasures are from the Dvaravati period, about 1,300 years ago. They also found metal sheets with beautiful Buddha carvings.

articles.title: July Is Ice Cream Month! Scoop Up These Cool Facts
articles.summary: National Ice Cream Month started in 1984 when President Reagan made it official. Americans eat about 23 pounds of ice cream per person each year. The world’s largest scoop weighed over 3,000 pounds and was carved by snow sculptors in Wisconsin.
